review_method: Every remediation candidate was compared with its frozen structured source record. Deterministic rejections confined to annotation coverage were overridden only after semantic review; semantic failures remained rejected evidence and were re-gated under a new prompt version without rewriting prior attempts.
resolved_failure_classes: unknown or absent nested facts invented as negatives
known negatives weakened into absence-of-report wording
positive versus negative drinking polarity reversal
current cough entry polarity or tense shift
initial wheezing conflated with recurrent wheeze
parent encounter-entry fact conflated with a nested finding
derived classification summaries introduced into source language
